title: The First Webcam Was Pointed at a Coffee Pot
description:
The world's first webcam wasn't built for video calls or security. It existed for one reason: so nobody had to walk to an empty coffee pot again.

#shorts #techfacts #techhistory

scenes.text: The world's first webcam was pointed at a coffee pot.
In 1991, researchers at Cambridge University's computer lab kept walking to their shared coffee machine, only to find it empty.
So they rigged a camera pointed at the pot, and wrote software so anyone in the building could check the coffee level from their desk.
In 1993, they put the feed online, and it became one of the most visited websites in the world.
People all over the planet were checking on a coffee pot in Cambridge, for years.
It finally got switched off in 2001, and the camera itself was later auctioned off for over three thousand pounds.
